# Hi Sisters Clinic

> Epilation and skin care clinic with two studios: Prague (Czech Republic) and Valencia (Spain). Laser hair removal, electrolysis, cosmetology, trichology, injectables, professional cosmetics and courses for specialists. Site languages: Russian, Ukrainian, Czech, English, Spanish.

## Facts
- Prague studio: Chlumčanského 497/5, Praha 8-Libeň, 180 00. Phone +420 702 192 946. Daily 10:00–19:00.
- Valencia studio: Carrer de Pere Aleixandre, 34, 46004 València. Phone +34 637 02 47 59. Mon–Sat 10:00–20:00.
- Prices are published on the site; the first consultation is free.
- Laser is used for dark hair; electrolysis removes light, red and grey hair and is the method offered for a woman's face.
- A laser course is usually 6–10 sessions with intervals growing from 4 to 8 weeks.
- Laser hair removal in Prague: from 550 CZK per zone, single session.
- Laser hair removal in Valencia: from 20 EUR per zone, single session.
- Full price list: https://hi-sisters.clinic/en/prague/prices/ and https://hi-sisters.clinic/en/valencia/prices/
